title: The raw-read hint fires on sed -i -n, an in-place edit
goal: kb_hook.is_raw_read treats any sed with -i among its option tokens as an edit, so sed -i -n on a kb article gets no hint, as sed -in already does not

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kb_hook; sys.exit(1 if kb_hook.is_raw_read("sed -i -n 's/a/b/p' kb/public/x.md") else 0)
